candidates.label: Purposeful creation for a specified term while the warned turn away
candidates.definition: In 46:3: We did not create the heavens and earth and what is between them except in truth and for a specified term; but those who disbelieve, from that of which they are warned, are turning away.

evidence.excerpt: مَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَأَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗىۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ عَمَّآ أُنذِرُواْ مُعۡرِضُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Challenge to produce rival creation or prior scripture as evidence
candidates.definition: In 46:4: Say have you considered that which you invoke besides Allah? Show me what they have created of the earth or did they have partnership in the heavens? Bring me a scripture before this or a remaining trace of knowledge if you should be truthful.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ لَهُمۡ شِرۡكٞ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِۖ ٱئۡتُونِي بِكِتَٰبٖ مِّن قَبۡلِ هَٰذَآ أَوۡ أَثَٰرَةٖ مِّنۡ عِلۡمٍ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Invoked entities unaware of worship becoming enemies at the gathering
candidates.definition: In 46:5-6: And who is more astray than he who invokes besides Allah those who will not respond to him until the Day of Resurrection and they of their invocation are unaware; and when the people are gathered they will be enemies to them and deniers of their worship.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَنۡ أَضَلُّ مِمَّن يَدۡعُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَن لَّا يَسۡتَجِيبُ لَهُۥٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وَهُمۡ عَن دُعَآئِهِمۡ غَٰفِلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَإِذَا حُشِرَ ٱلنَّاسُ كَانُواْ لَهُمۡ أَعۡدَآءٗ وَكَانُواْ بِعِبَادَتِهِمۡ كَٰفِرِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Israelite witness confirming the Quran while disbelievers remain arrogant
candidates.definition: In 46:10: Say have you considered if the Quran was from Allah and you disbelieved in it while a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to something similar and believed while you were arrogant? Indeed Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِن كَانَ مِنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَفَرۡتُم بِهِۦ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٞ مِّنۢ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ عَلَىٰ مِثۡلِهِۦ فَـَٔامَنَ وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرۡتُمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Musa's Scripture as guidance and mercy confirmed by this Arabic Book
candidates.definition: In 46:12: And before it was the scripture of Moses to lead and as a mercy; and this is a confirming Book in an Arabic tongue to warn those who have wronged and as good tidings to the doers of good.

evidence.excerpt: وَمِن قَبۡلِهِۦ كِتَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِمَامٗا وَرَحۡمَةٗۚ وَهَٰذَا كِتَٰبٞ مُّصَدِّقٞ لِّسَانًا عَرَبِيّٗا لِّيُنذِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ وَبُشۡرَىٰ لِلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Steadfastness after declaring Allah as Lord removing fear and grief
candidates.definition: In 46:13-14: Indeed those who have said our Lord is Allah and then remained on a right course, there will be no fear concerning them nor will they grieve; those are the companions of Paradise abiding eternally therein as reward for what they used to do.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُواْ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَقَٰمُواْ فَلَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا جَزَآءَۢ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Parental good-treatment enjoined with biological timeline and maturity supplication
candidates.definition: In 46:15: And We have enjoined upon man to his parents good treatment; his mother carried him with hardship and gave birth with hardship, and his gestation and weaning is thirty months; until when he reaches maturity and forty years he says my Lord enable me to be grateful for Your favour upon me and my parents and to work righteousness You approve and make righteous my offspring; indeed I have repented and am of the Muslims.

evidence.excerpt: وَوَصَّيۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيۡهِ إِحۡسَٰنًاۖ حَمَلَتۡهُ أُمُّهُۥ كُرۡهٗا وَوَضَعَتۡهُ كُرۡهٗاۖ وَحَمۡلُهُۥ وَفِصَٰلُهُۥ ثَلَٰثُونَ شَهۡرًاۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ وَبَلَغَ أَرۡبَعِينَ سَنَةٗ قَالَ رَبِّ أَوۡزِعۡنِيٓ أَنۡ أَشۡكُرَ نِعۡمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَيَّ وَأَنۡ أَعۡمَلَ صَٰلِحٗا تَرۡضَىٰهُ وَأَصۡلِحۡ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِيٓۖ إِنِّي تُبۡتُ إِلَيۡكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Contemptuous rejection of resurrection by a child against pleading parents
candidates.definition: In 46:17: But one who says to his parents uff to you, do you promise me I will be brought forth when generations before me have passed on, while they call to Allah for help and say woe to you believe, indeed the promise of Allah is truth; but he says this is not but legends of the former people.

evidence.excerpt: وَٱلَّذِي قَالَ لِوَٰلِدَيۡهِ أُفّٖ لَّكُمَآ أَتَعِدَانِنِيٓ أَنۡ أُخۡرَجَ وَقَدۡ خَلَتِ ٱلۡقُرُونُ مِن قَبۡلِي وَهُمَا يَسۡتَغِيثَانِ ٱللَّهَ وَيۡلَكَ ءَامِنۡ إِنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٞ فَيَقُولُ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Word taking effect among prior nations of jinn and men as losers
candidates.definition: In 46:18: Those are the ones upon whom the word has come into effect among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men; indeed they all were losers.

evidence.excerpt: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ حَقَّ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ فِيٓ أُمَمٖ قَدۡ خَلَتۡ مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ خَٰسِرِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Haqqah al-qawl as divine word taking effect.

candidates.label: Pleasure exhaustion in worldly life answered by humiliating punishment
candidates.definition: In 46:20: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire it will be said you exhausted your pleasures during your worldly life and enjoyed them, so this Day you will be awarded the punishment of extreme humiliation because you were arrogant upon the earth without right and defiantly disobedient.

evidence.excerpt: وَيَوۡمَ يُعۡرَضُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ أَذۡهَبۡتُمۡ طَيِّبَٰتِكُمۡ فِي حَيَاتِكُمُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱسۡتَمۡتَعۡتُم بِهَا فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ تُجۡزَوۡنَ عَذَابَ ٱلۡهُونِ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَفۡسُقُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Brother of Aad warning in al-Ahqaf amid prior and subsequent warners
candidates.definition: In 46:21-23: And mention the brother of Aad when he warned his people in al-Ahqaf, and warners had passed before him and after him, saying do not worship except Allah, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day; they said have you come to delude us from our gods, bring what you promise if truthful; he said knowledge is only with Allah and I convey what I was sent with but I see you behaving ignorantly.

evidence.excerpt: ۞وَٱذۡكُرۡ أَخَا عَادٍ إِذۡ أَنذَرَ قَوۡمَهُۥ بِٱلۡأَحۡقَافِ وَقَدۡ خَلَتِ ٱلنُّذُرُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِۦٓ أَلَّا تَعۡبُدُوٓاْ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: قَالُوٓاْ أَجِئۡتَنَا لِتَأۡفِكَنَا عَنۡ ءَالِهَتِنَا فَأۡتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: قَالَ إِنَّمَا ٱلۡعِلۡمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَأُبَلِّغُكُم مَّآ أُرۡسِلۡتُ بِهِۦ وَلَٰكِنِّيٓ أَرَىٰكُمۡ قَوۡمٗا تَجۡهَلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Approaching cloud mistaken for rain revealed as destructive wind
candidates.definition: In 46:24-25: And when they saw it as a cloud approaching their valleys they said this is a cloud bringing us rain; rather it is that for which you were impatient, a wind within it a painful punishment, destroying everything by command of its Lord; and they became so that nothing was seen except their dwellings; thus do We recompense the criminal people.

evidence.excerpt: فَلَمَّا رَأَوۡهُ عَارِضٗا مُّسۡتَقۡبِلَ أَوۡدِيَتِهِمۡ قَالُواْ هَٰذَا عَارِضٞ مُّمۡطِرُنَاۚ بَلۡ هُوَ مَا ٱسۡتَعۡجَلۡتُم بِهِۦۖ رِيحٞ فِيهَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَيۡءِۭ بِأَمۡرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصۡبَحُواْ لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَٰكِنُهُمۡۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Faculties availing nothing when signs are persistently rejected
candidates.definition: In 46:26: And We had established them in such as We have not established you and made for them hearing and vision and hearts, but their hearing and vision and hearts availed them not from anything when they were rejecting the signs of Allah, and they were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَقَدۡ مَكَّنَّـٰهُمۡ فِيمَآ إِن مَّكَّنَّـٰكُمۡ فِيهِ وَجَعَلۡنَا لَهُمۡ سَمۡعٗا وَأَبۡصَٰرٗا وَأَفۡـِٔدَةٗ فَمَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُمۡ سَمۡعُهُمۡ وَلَآ أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ وَلَآ أَفۡـِٔدَتُهُم مِّن شَيۡءٍ إِذۡ كَانُواْ يَجۡحَدُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Jinn directed to listen to the Quran and returning as warners
candidates.definition: In 46:29-31: And when We directed to you a few of the jinn listening to the Quran, when they attended it they said listen quietly, and when concluded they went back to their people as warners; they said O our people we have heard a Book revealed after Musa confirming what was before it guiding to truth and a straight path; O our people respond to the Messenger of Allah and believe in him, He will forgive your sins and protect you from painful punishment.

evidence.excerpt: وَإِذۡ صَرَفۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ نَفَرٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ فَلَمَّا حَضَرُوهُ قَالُوٓاْ أَنصِتُواْۖ فَلَمَّا قُضِيَ وَلَّوۡاْ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: قَالُواْ يَٰقَوۡمَنَآ إِنَّا سَمِعۡنَا كِتَٰبًا أُنزِلَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مُوسَىٰ مُصَدِّقٗا لِّمَا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِ يَهۡدِيٓ إِلَى ٱلۡحَقِّ وَإِلَىٰ طَرِيقٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: يَٰقَوۡمَنَآ أَجِيبُواْ دَاعِيَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَامِنُواْ بِهِۦ يَغۡفِرۡ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمۡ وَيُجِرۡكُم مِّنۡ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٖ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Cosmic creation proving ability to revive the dead
candidates.definition: In 46:33: Do they not see that Allah who created the heavens and earth and did not fail in their creation is able to give life to the dead? Yes indeed He is over all things competent.

evidence.excerpt: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَلَمۡ يَعۡيَ بِخَلۡقِهِنَّ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحۡـِۧيَ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰۚ بَلَىٰٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Patience modelled on determined messengers with the Day compressing time
candidates.definition: In 46:35: So be patient as were those of determination among the messengers and do not be impatient for them; it will be on the Day they see what they are promised as though they had not remained except an hour of a day; this is notification, and will any be destroyed except the defiantly disobedient people?

evidence.excerpt: فَٱصۡبِرۡ كَمَا صَبَرَ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡعَزۡمِ مِنَ ٱلرُّسُلِ وَلَا تَسۡتَعۡجِل لَّهُمۡۚ كَأَنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَ مَا يُوعَدُونَ لَمۡ يَلۡبَثُوٓاْ إِلَّا سَاعَةٗ مِّن نَّهَارِۭۚ بَلَٰغٞۚ فَهَلۡ يُهۡلَكُ إِلَّا ٱلۡقَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَٰسِقُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.
